title: fix(kql): escape characters outside the BMP correctly in string literals

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 
 ### Fixed
 
+- KQL string literals and query parameters now escape characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (such as emoji) with the eight-digit `\U` form, instead of a `\u` escape that decoded to a different string.
 - Null values added as query parameters or through the KQL builder are now written as typed null literals (such as `dynamic(null)` or `int(null)`). A null `Dynamic` was written as an empty `dynamic()`, and the other null types caused a panic.
 - KQL builders and query parameters now format negative timespans with a single leading sign and preserve the day component.

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+package kql
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+)
+
+func TestQuoteStringUnicodeEscapes(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name     string
+		value    string
+		expected string
+	}{
+		{"BMP", "\u65e5", `"\u65e5"`},
+		{"last BMP code point", "\uffff", `"\uffff"`},
+		{"first supplementary code point", "\U00010000", `"\U00010000"`},
+		{"emoji", "a\U0001f642b", `"a\U0001f642b"`},
+		{"last code point", "\U0010ffff", `"\U0010ffff"`},
+	}
+
+	for _, test := range tests {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			assert.Equal(t, test.expected, QuoteString(test.value, false))
+		})
+	}
+
+	assert.Equal(t, `"\U0001f642"`, New("").AddString("\U0001f642").String())
+	assert.Equal(t, `"\U0001f642"`, NewParameters().AddString("s", "\U0001f642").ToParameterCollection()["s"])
+}
